description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs: delta CRL verification (verify sig, check expiry, collect entries) appears near-identically in both check_revocation (lines ~279-350) and check_revocation_against_anchor (lines ~456-499).

Extract a helper fn verify_and_collect_delta_entries(delta_der, verifier, issuer_spki, issuer_name, now_unix) -> Result<Vec<RevokedCert>>.

Both callers reduce to one call. If delta CRL logic changes later it must currently be updated in two places.
title: M7: Delta-CRL verification block duplicated ~70 lines in CrlChecker
